pilot_manifest_comparison.query_budget_confound: source_classwise uses 10k queries/update while range_class_sampler uses 16k queries/update; equal update counts are not equal query budgets

static_findings.effect: Low pointwise BCE does not guarantee correct within-range top-10k ordering or calibration under the 5 cm capacity filter.
static_findings.finding: Training receives binary occupied/empty labels and never receives target_xyz_confidence, but exact export sorts roughly 700k continuous candidates by sigmoid occupancy confidence within each range.
static_findings.minimum_patch: Add a ranking-aware calibration term on a frozen candidate subset, or train confidence against target distance/importance while retaining the existing occupancy term.

static_findings.effect: A resumed run or two pilot modes can silently consume different data while passing the current resume and comparison checks.
static_findings.finding: resume_contract binds manifest/split/normalization/source hashes but does not bind data_root, cache_root, per-cache digests, or Cube files.
static_findings.minimum_patch: Bind an ordered cache digest, cache metadata source commit, data-root identity, and preferably an ordered Cube digest/index into the run manifest and resume contract.

static_findings.effect: A modified reference can change epoch-3/5 decisions after resume.
static_findings.finding: On resume, formal_reference.json is trusted after checking only the baseline input hashes; its own digest and metric/value consistency are not part of the checkpoint contract.
static_findings.minimum_patch: Recompute/verify formal reference values on resume and bind the reference JSON digest to the checkpoint.

static_findings.effect: Far-range confidence calibration and residual learning are not equally weighted even when the primary BCE is range balanced.
static_findings.finding: Only occupancy BCE is normalized per range/class. Brier is a global mean over 15k negatives and 1k positives; residual Smooth L1 is a global mean over positives with a 700/200/100 range mix.
static_findings.minimum_patch: Report auxiliary gradients by range; if material, normalize Brier and positive residual by range with weights frozen before comparison.

static_findings.effect: A difference cannot be attributed solely to range normalization or hard-negative composition.
static_findings.finding: source_classwise uses 10k queries/update and range_class_sampler uses 16k queries/update for the same 380 updates.
static_findings.minimum_patch: Either match total decoded queries or describe R-A2 as a sampler bundle comparison rather than an isolated loss ablation.

static_findings.effect: Resume is seed-reproducible but not guaranteed bitwise deterministic.
static_findings.finding: RNG states are checkpointed, but deterministic algorithms, SDPA backend, physical GPU identity, driver, and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES are not frozen.
static_findings.minimum_patch: Freeze deterministic backend settings and runtime/device identity, then run an uninterrupted-versus-resumed checkpoint hash test.
